safety.note: Classification only. No supabase_migrations row was repaired, renamed or re-run. Any action below goes through PRODUCTION_MIGRATION_READY.

vocabulary.HOTFIX_NOT_BACKPORTED: Production carries a function body that no repo file defines (body digest differs from every repo definition of the same signature). The repo does not describe what production runs.
vocabulary.LEGIT_LEGACY: Production applied a small, additive piece of an older design; its effect is present and nothing in the repo contradicts it.
vocabulary.SPLIT_CHUNK_OF_REPO_FILE: Production applied one function of a repo file as its own history row; the body digest equals the repo definition.
vocabulary.UNKNOWN: Cannot be classified from committed evidence. requiredProof names the schema read that settles it.

method: Per row: structural signature of the applied production SQL (scripts/lib/migration-semantic-reconcile.mjs extractStructuralSignature) compared to every repo definition of the same object; function body compared by whitespace-insensitive digest. Live md5 values in rc2-3-10b-live-facts.json are over pg_get_functiondef and are NOT comparable to repo text, so they prove nothing here.

placeholderNeighbours.rule: Placeholder history rows are UNKNOWN until schema proof exists. Their real SQL was applied outside supabase_migrations, so a PROD_ONLY chunk may have been overwritten by a later placeholder-recorded statement.

rows.name: harden_economy_claim_mission
rows.object: function:public.claim_mission(p_scope text,p_mission_id text,p_period_key text,p_metric_value integer default 0)
evidence: Reconciler: production SQL matches no repo file structurally (status UNKNOWN, confidence 0, candidateRepoFiles empty).

Same signature exists in supabase/migrations/006_economy_server.sql, 20260808130000_harden_economy_reward_trust.sql and 20260808140000_economy_anti_cheat_qi.sql; non-body attributes are equal (plpgsql, security definer, returns jsonb, no config) but the body digest differs from all three (production 6a9285aaf38d).

Semantic drift: the production body clamps and trusts p_metric_value (v_metric := greatest(0, least(p_metric_value, 100000))) and returns mission_incomplete; the repo anti-cheat body ignores p_metric_value and calls economy_verified_mission_metric(...). Production messages are ASCII-folded (scope invalido) while the repo uses accents.
rows.risk: If the live body is this chunk, the repo's server-verified mission metric is not what runs in production. Live body unknown: later history rows 20260808134423 / 20260808134424 are placeholders.
rows.requiredProof: Dump pg_get_functiondef(public.claim_mission) from production and diff against supabase/migrations/20260808140000_economy_anti_cheat_qi.sql.
rows.action: Do not repair, rename or re-run this row. After the diff, either backport the live body to the repo as a new migration or apply the repo definition through PRODUCTION_MIGRATION_READY.
